limitations: The same 96 NLBSE 2023 issues and their labels have been reused across prompt experiments; this is exploratory, not independent generalization evidence.
The candidate was hand-assembled using live MCP get_taxonomy rules and developer-domain disambiguation. It is NOT an automatically optimized GEPA/MIPROv2 output.
MCP classification endpoint uses Cloudflare Llama3.3 70B, while this run tests pinned local Qwen2.5-1.5B; never compare their dev-set accuracies directly.
Only Qwen GGUF CPU/llama.cpp is measured; browser WebLLM/iOS CORS not tested.
No changes to production, separate B2B service-intake taxonomy or previously sealed independent holdout.

paired_accuracy_delta.interpretation: diagnostic uncertainty under within-class resampling; not full-population or cross-project inference

full_report.source_mcp: SFS Prompt Lab MCP get_taxonomy version 2.0

decision.verdict: No Qwen accuracy improvement. Macro-F1 decreases and Question recall decreases. Keep current Qwen prompt; no production merge.
decision.caveats: MCP classification itself uses Llama 3.3 70B, not Qwen. MCP's get_taxonomy is not a GEPA/MIPROv2 champion, and repeated prior 96 cases are not an independent holdout.
